findings_and_questions.first_contract: The local wall-frame predicate reports valid for a ChurchApse wall whose raw tangent has a NaN component while outward is finite and unit. In the apse branch the cardinal-vector match is skipped; the length and dot comparisons with NaN are false. This mathematical consequence is confined to wall_frame::valid and its wall-frame check; it does not establish that the remaining whole-plan audit passes or that a generated or decoded plan supplies such a wall.
findings_and_questions.condition: Direct construction or another admissible producer must supply a NaN-bearing apse tangent. No actual source producer, all plan checks, serialization format acceptance, runtime consequence, or ordinary incidence was established. Noncardinal finite apse frames are supported by the explicit exemption.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: At the owner decide finite point/direction and orthogonal-basis admission and audit semantics for legitimate diagonal apse frames. Preserve accepted tolerances and contextual issue attribution; validate against actual producer and full audit boundaries before assigning impact.

findings_and_questions.first_contract: WallLocalFrame and OpeningAssembly retain raw public origin, tangent and outward independently. Operable compilation normalizes each opening direction separately; the resulting individually checked directions and public WindowSpec fields do not establish orthogonality, a hinge/centre relation, or which outward vector makes the chosen sign inward. Fixed-bar compilation instead requires each input direction already normalized. A unit but non-orthogonal pair can pass those individual direction admissions; downstream policy and whether such an opening is acceptable remain unproved.

No claim ordinary authored plans, every audit check, or runtime behavior are defective.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Determine the exact opening-to-host frame and accepted-plan boundary, require coherent basis and declared inward convention only where applicable, and retain legitimate apse directions, source/error identity and current native-versus-pre-normalized policy.

findings_and_questions.first_contract: compile_operable_windows builds an ID-keyed BTreeMap from all solids, so a duplicate ID resolves to the last solid; it then picks the first referenced solid with LeadedGlazing or OpeningClosure role. A missing or wrong-role reference is skipped if a later candidate qualifies; an eligible opening with none yields source-aware MissingClosure. Public plan and solid IDs leave uniqueness and owner/layer relationships to other boundaries not proved here.
findings_and_questions.condition: Duplicate, missing, or misdirected references must reach this compiler and the selected fallback must violate a policy the actual producer/consumer owns. No supported normal generated violation, receiver or incident established. A first valid optional layer may be intentional.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Establish unique resolved IDs and closure-layer membership/owner/order at the actual accepted-plan boundary, decide whether skipped missing or incompatible members are intentional, preserve supported roles and contextual typed errors.

nonfindings: The explicit minimum 0.025 metre leaf thickness is an observed physical representation choice; not by itself an invalid input or compatibility defect.
Iron bars are documented to compile independently of operable state; independent state is not by itself a defect.
Window leaf selection filters accepted solid roles, and MissingClosure retains all closure source IDs plus opening ID; zero eligible closures is not silently returned as a window.
Individual checked leaf construction and contextual GeometryError do not by themselves establish cross-field relationships; tests and fixtures were inspected as text only.

lenses.bounded_assessment: Wall source/use/closure modes and WindowErrorCause are closed types; snake_case tags and error messages are serialization or presentation boundaries in the displayed scope. No business decision on mutable prose was identified.

Width threshold, swing angle, minimum leaf thickness and direction probe are named at the window producer. Wall material ranges encode profile policy, not automatically one interchangeable quantity. Bar packing is a distinct ID namespace question.

WallLocalFrame retains raw vectors even though PlanDirection already owns normalized framed directions. The retained basis contract is linked to 059 L13; bars and window leaf data represent distinct policies and identity roles.

PlanDirection, Position, LeafDimensions, Radians and typed opening/source IDs already own leaf semantics; retain the actual native computation boundary and do not discard those owners. A checked leaf alone does not validate a whole frame.

Room Option<u16>, profile dimensions and closure layers have distinct units, identities and modes. Resolving their semantic owner requires actual producer and consumer, not merely wrapping every scalar or conflating wall and opening frame.

Window frame normalization, hinge and signed swing computations and material predicates have separate input contracts. NaN apse audit comparison and fortified infinity remain strictly conditional; no test or fixture execution.

A pair of individually admitted directions need not establish an orthogonal host/opening basis, and resolved closure IDs need not establish uniqueness, ordering, ownership or role compatibility. Audit the true accepted aggregate boundary.

Raw public WallLocalFrame/WallAssembly/OpeningAssembly are directly constructible; WindowSpec custom deserialize checks individual leaves and attaches contextual errors. Whether all external formats admit NaN or plans are audited before use is not proven.

OpeningUse, ClosureKind, ClosureState, WindowLeafKind and WindowBarPresence give modes explicit names. Closure layers and operable state remain independently combinable; legitimate multilayer policy is unresolved.

Opening and wall each retain frame and source associations; references select from separately retained solids. Establish what may differ by design and which boundary owns the relationship before labeling duplicated authority.

P16 and 95e individual objects match, while 059/774 reads remain historically attributed. Preserve fixed bars independent of casement state, supported glazing and shutter roles, noncardinal apse geometry, source-specific errors and deliberate minimum thickness.

Native opening-frame vectors enter PlanDirection at consumers. Historical 774 TRACE-001 and F001 describe checked window output and its computed dimensions; F009 is a separate glass leaf/builder forwarding path. The historical bar re-admission signal is already recorded by 059 and the earlier collision reviewer.

Enums and wall records use derives and WindowSpec uses contextual custom deserialization. No derive substitution is justified without preserving checked-leaf admission, error ordering, frame and aggregate policy.
